items.title: Built for competitive ad markets
items.text: Search and social advertising in the US is crowded. Campaigns are structured tightly, with clear tracking, so budget goes to what brings enquiries.

items.title: Accessibility and privacy in mind
items.text: Websites are built to recognised accessibility standards and with a clear, honest approach to cookies and customer data.

items.title: Fast answers for every enquiry
items.text: AI agents and automations reply to new leads straight away, qualify them and book the call — including outside office hours.

blocks.title: Five services. Take one, or
blocks.lead: Every service is available on its own, with a custom quote. No forced bundles.

items.q: Do you work with businesses in every US state?
items.a: Yes. Keelbiz works remotely, so we support businesses anywhere in the United States by video call and email, at a time that suits your working day.

items.q: Which services can I hire on their own?
items.a: Any of them. Website design and development, social media management, Meta and Google Ads, AI agents and automation, and business dashboards are each available separately or combined.

items.q: Do you manage both Google Ads and Meta Ads?
items.a: Yes. We manage Google Ads and Meta (Facebook and Instagram) campaigns, and recommend the mix after a short discovery call.
Every project gets a custom quote after a short discovery call. Third-party costs such as ad spend, domains or software subscriptions are paid by you directly and are always shown separately.
